headline: Hold at 8 of 8
paragraph: Quant Flow Capital tracks eight major central banks as they navigate the current economic cycle. Right now, all eight central banks share a baseline expectation to hold their interest rates steady. Among them, the Swiss National Bank stands out by maintaining a rate of 0.00% as inflation sits quietly inside its target zone.
